summary: Publix Super Markets filed a routine Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of 11.6 cents per share, payable November 2, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business October 15, 2026. The company operates 1,443 grocery stores across eight southeastern states and is the largest employee-owned company in the U.S. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, regulatory clock, or structural overhang is disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement with no special-situations angle to trade.
